overview.summary: Escape the Mumbai hustle with a serene solo weekend in Mahabaleshwar, soaking in misty hills and strawberry farms.
overview.best_time_note: Early August offers pleasant monsoon‑fresh weather and fewer crowds.

options.details: State transport (MSRTC) non‑AC semi‑sleeper, departs 07:00 from Mumbai ST stand, arrives Mahabaleshwar 12:30.

transport.recommendation_reason: Lowest cost fits tight budget, acceptable travel time for a solo traveler.
transport.local_transport: Auto‑rickshaws and shared taxis available at the bus depot

stay.area_recommendation: Mahabaleshwar market area – close to eateries, strawberry farms and main viewpoints.

options.name: Hotel Hilltop
options.why_good: Clean basic rooms, rooftop view, walking distance to points of interest

morning.tip: Carry water and a light snack

afternoon.activity: Lunch at local eatery – masala dosa (≈80)

places_to_visit.name: Wilson Point
places_to_visit.why_visit: Highest point in Mahabaleshwar with panoramic sunrise/sunset views

places_to_visit.name: Mapro Garden
places_to_visit.why_visit: Taste fresh strawberry products and learn about local processing

places_to_visit.name: Pratapgad Fort
places_to_visit.why_visit: Explore Maratha history and enjoy hilltop vistas

safety_and_tips: Carry cash in small denominations for local vendors
Stay hydrated, especially during hill treks
Watch out for slippery paths after rain
